name: bullia
description: Read your own Bullia trading journal in ChatGPT: performance, trades, strategies, behavior, risk and calendar.

interface.longDescription:
Bullia is a trading journal for retail traders. Connect your existing Bullia account and ask about your own results in plain language: performance, trades, strategies, tags, timing, behavior such as revenge trading, risk, open positions, reports and the calendar.

What it is for: understanding past trading. It is for people who already keep their journal in Bullia and have a Bullia account.

Optional changes: if you tick a separate permission when connecting, the assistant can also create a strategy, delete a strategy nothing uses, create a tag, add or remove a trade's tags, and link a trade that has no strategy.

Limitations: it never places trades or moves money, and it cannot change a trade's details, trade notes or your journal. It gives no investment advice. Each customer has limits on how much can be read per request, per hour and per day.
defaultPrompt: How did my trading go this month?
Which day of the week costs me the most?
What happened on my worst trading day?

positive.description: An overall summary of the customer's own results.
positive.prompt: How did my trading go overall?
positive.expected_behavior: States net result, win rate, number of trades and profit factor from the tool result, with the period and currency, and gives no advice.

positive.description: An analysis card chosen from the customer's question.
positive.prompt: Which day of the week costs me the most?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the matching card, reads it and names the weekday with its figure from the result.
Reports that day's result and its trades from the tool result.

positive.description: A change the customer asks for, on a connection that allowed changes.
positive.prompt: Create a strategy called Morning breakout.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates exactly one strategy with that name and says it was created. Asking again reports that it already exists.

positive.description: Tagging one named trade, on a connection that allowed changes.
positive.prompt: Add the tag Reviewed to my NVDA trade from October 14, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the tag to that one trade, keeps its other tags and says what changed.

negative.description: Placing a trade is outside the plugin. It has no tool for it and should say so.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of NVDA for me.

negative.description: Investment advice is outside the plugin. It should read nothing from Bullia for this and use none of the customer's figures. ChatGPT may still answer in general terms from its own knowledge and web results, which do not come from this plugin.
negative.prompt: Should I buy Tesla tomorrow, and how large should the position be?

negative.description: Writing the journal is outside the plugin. It has no tool for it and should say nothing was saved.
negative.prompt: Write a note on my last trade and add an entry to today's journal.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your own Bullia journal, with optional small changes.
